definitions.explanation: Describes something exceptionally large in size, used for products, portions, and items that exceed the standard large size.

examples.japanese: {特大|とくだい}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'd like the extra-large size, please.

examples.japanese: {特大|とくだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦スタンド→スタンド：00394_sutando⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧。
examples.english: A towering home run flew into the stands.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特大|とくだい}⟦パフェ→パフェ：11122_pafe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧きれないほど⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: This shop's jumbo parfait is so big that one person can't finish it.

notes: Functions as a pre-noun modifier: {特大|とくだい}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧ (extra-large size), {特大|とくだい}⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧ (big news), {特大|とくだい}⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧ (towering home run). Often used in product descriptions and restaurant menus. The prefix {特|とく}～ means "special" and appears in many compounds: ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ (express train), ⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧ (special sale). Related: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧ (large-sized — a standard descriptor), {超大型|ちょうおおがた} (super-large).
